strongest_angle: The 13.46-meter Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM named 'Panamá' completed the longest single-pass tunnel segment for the new Metro Line 3, marking a significant milestone in the Panama Canal construction.

key_facts.fact: The 13.46-meter diameter Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM named 'Panamá' completed a 4.5-kilometer drive beneath the Panama Canal on October 26, 2026, enabling a 12-kilometer underground rail link.
The tuneladora Panamá, a 13.46-meter diameter Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM, completed a 4.5-kilometer drive beneath the Panama Canal, marking the first bored tunnel under the waterway.

The tuneladora Panamá, a 13.46-meter diameter Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM, broke through at Albrook on October 26, 2026, completing its 4.5-kilometer drive from Farfán, which is part of the construction of the Línea 3 Metro in Panama.
